search.title: Parano1d (NOID) | SafeTrade
search.snippet: Parano1d is designed around a proof-native architecture in which the current blockchain State carries a recursive proof of its valid ancestry. Instead of requiring a new node to replay historical transactions from genesis, a node can authenticate the live UTXO State using its terminal proof and a recent block suffix. The network uses Proof of Work to establish canonical ordering among already-proven State transitions. Miners construct and prove the complete transaction and State transition before searching for a valid nonce.
